# ui-utils-kit documentation

ui-utils-kit is a TypeScript utility library for tree data operations, common asynchronous utilities, and browser DOM capture.

- Home: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/
- Getting started: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/guide/getting-started
- Behavior and boundaries: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/guide/behavior
- Tree API: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/api/tree
- Common API: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/api/common
- Business API: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/api/business
- FAQ: https://ofreshman.github.io/ui-utils-kit/guide/faq
- Source: https://github.com/OFreshman/ui-utils-kit
